editor_reconstruction_note: Single-frame appearance of a framed chalkboard panel (with tray) holding a Mariana Trench cross-section: black ground, grey water funnel with streak lines, white text 'MARIANA TRENCH', small red mark at funnel bottom. Label and figure unchanged.
Over 6 frames the grey water surface drops step by step down the funnel (f72 high, f74 about mid-height, f77 only in lower V); black ground edges unchanged.
Panel contents replaced in one frame: trench gone; white panel with thin red horizontal line near top, black ground strip at bottom with white text 'MARS'. Title label and figure persist.
Tiny rover with small '!' mark appears on the black ground above 'MARS' in one frame.
Grey vertical water curtain with streaks falls from the red line to the ground with splash shapes either side; rover now partly hidden. One frame.
Panel becomes black: grey-white Earth globe upper, small brown Mars below, grey water stream between them. 'PREVIOUSLY ON' label gone; stick figure now holds a sheet of paper. One frame.
Hard cut to full-bleed colour illustration: grey-tan sky, brown Mars ground, large Gale crater with Mount Sharp mound, tiny rover at crater left edge. Stick figure and panel gone.
Small black arrows appear in one frame at right edge, near the horizon and below the crater (first markers). UNRESOLVED exact count.
Label '-65 C' with downward arrow appears upper-left above horizon, black ink.
Label '~0.006x EARTH PRESSURE' with curved arrow appears to the right of '-65 C' above horizon.

Hard cut to side cross-section: tan sky, black ground, crater at left holding small pool, Mount Sharp peak at middle, tall grey water column capped with red line, light-grey pool right; small rover at column base.
Label '-100 C - 0 C' appears upper-left of water column.

Right half changes in one frame: ground slopes down to a larger grey sea with fish silhouettes, ice-shelf line on top, ions 'Na+' 'Cl-' 'Mg2+', white background right with label '-30 C - 0 C'; ions 'Mg2+' 'Cl-' 'Na+' also near crater.
Hard cut to white canvas: title 'ELEVATION MARS', LOW-HIGH grey gradient legend, framed greyscale elevation map of Mars with small place labels (unreadable at tile scale).
Red dot at Curiosity location on map with two diverging black lines to an inset box titled 'GALE CRATER' showing zoomed map with 'MT. SHARP' and 'CURIOSITY'.
Hard cut to cross-section: tan sky, black ground, crater dip, Mount Sharp peak labelled 'MT. SHARP', 'GALE CRATER' text below, water column with red cap and splash at left.
Thin pale water line appears on the crater floor at right of peak (lowest pool state).
Grey water fills crater floor, rover visible at left under water, level around Mount Sharp base.
Pool rises to near crater rim with wavy surface line; Mount Sharp mostly above water.
Over 6 frames text 'ANCHOR ICE' fades in at right of pool and a white ice band forms along the pool edge; water fill lightens/darkens in the right part.
Small black specks appear in the water/ice (debris), in one frame.
Hard cut to top-down map on tan: blue lake with black outline around crater, dashed circle labelled 'GALE CRATER', 'CURIOSITY' with arrow to red dot, short branching blue river to north.
Blue river extends far north with loops in a single frame (no write-on visible in samples).
Large blue lake appears at top of canvas connected to river end; one frame.
Blue fills change to white with black dots (ice) in crater lake, river and top lake in one frame, with some blue remaining.

Hard cut to white canvas: label 'MARS' above framed map with tan fill, white regions, place labels (Phoenix, Matt Damon, Pathfinder, Perseverance, Opportunity, Curiosity, Spirit, Mars 2, Viking 2, Mars Polar Lander, Insight, Tianwen); stick figure lower-left.
Over 6 frames lighter blobs fade into the tan map and tan fill clears in places, leaving white flooded areas with outlines. UNRESOLVED which regions flip.
Label 'HELLAS IMPACT CRATER' appears under the large white blob.
Hard cut to tan sky over black ground: large grey breaking wave left, Perseverance rover right with label 'PERSEVERANCE' and arrow.
Wave replaced by grey churning water band with debris and foam; rover now tilted/tumbled at right; label arrow kept.
Cut back to white map canvas with figure; tan land shrinks to a small left remnant and specks at f1850, fades to only tiny outlined islands by f1857.
Hard cut to cross-section: tan sky, black ground, light-grey water band with wavy surface, column with red cap, grass-like splash; no figure.
Over 6 frames the surface wave line is replaced by white ice with black specks at top and bottom of the layer; column fades out.
Subtle mid-band texture change across 6 frames (grey band flickers/brightens). UNRESOLVED exact change.
Remaining grey middle band fades out over 6 frames leaving a fully white speckled ice layer.
Hard cut to white canvas: framed panel containing the frozen layer (tan top, speckled white, black bottom) with tray; stick figure lower-left.
Red zigzag scribble appears across the ice; only one sample frame so write-on timing UNRESOLVED.
Panel contents replaced by white panel: spiky outlined sun top, grey clouds, curved line labelled 'MARS'.
Many grey curved arrows appear between ground, clouds and sun.
Black panel: brown Earth labelled 'EARTH (DEHYDRATED)' and small blue Mars 'MARS (JUST ADD WATER)'.
Panel returns to opening waterfall over Mars with rover and red line, 'MARS'; figure now has arms out (shrug).
Everything vanishes in one frame to blank white canvas.
